what is c.en: C is a general-purpose, procedural programming language developed by Dennis Ritchie.
what is c.te: C anedi Dennis Ritchie develop chesina general-purpose programming language.

features of c.en: C is fast, portable, structured and close to hardware.
features of c.te: C fast, portable, structured mariyu hardware ki close ga untundi.

structure of c program.en: A C program consists of headers, main function, variables and statements.
structure of c program.te: C program lo headers, main function, variables mariyu statements untayi.

data types in c.en: C supports int, float, char, double and void data types.
data types in c.te: C lo int, float, char, double mariyu void data types untayi.

variables in c.en: Variables are used to store data values in memory.
variables in c.te: Variables memory lo data ni store cheyyadaniki use chestaru.

operators in c.en: C supports arithmetic, relational, logical, assignment and bitwise operators.
operators in c.te: C lo arithmetic, relational, logical, assignment mariyu bitwise operators untayi.

if else in c.en: if-else statements are used for decision making.
if else in c.te: if-else statements decisions teesukovadaniki use chestaru.

loops in c.en: C supports for loop, while loop and do-while loop.
loops in c.te: C lo for, while mariyu do-while loops untayi.

functions in c.en: Functions are blocks of code that perform a specific task.
functions in c.te: Functions oka specific task ni perform chese code blocks.

recursion in c.en: Recursion is a function calling itself.
recursion in c.te: Recursion ante function thane thanu call cheskovadam.

arrays in c.en: Arrays are used to store multiple values of same data type.
arrays in c.te: Arrays same data type values ni store cheyyadaniki use chestaru.

strings in c.en: Strings are arrays of characters ending with null character.
strings in c.te: Strings ante characters array, last lo null character untundi.

pointers in c.en: Pointers store the address of another variable.
pointers in c.te: Pointers inkoka variable address ni store chestayi.

structures in c.en: Structures are used to group different data types.
structures in c.te: Structures different data types ni group cheyyadaniki use chestaru.

unions in c.en: Unions allow storing different data types in same memory location.
unions in c.te: Unions same memory lo different data types ni store cheyyadaniki allow chestayi.

file handling in c.en: File handling is used to store data permanently using files.
file handling in c.te: File handling files lo data permanently store cheyyadaniki use chestaru.

dynamic memory allocation.en: Dynamic memory allocation uses malloc, calloc, realloc and free.
dynamic memory allocation.te: Dynamic memory allocation malloc, calloc, realloc mariyu free use chestundi.
